task.prompt:
Consider the overdetermined linear system A x = b with the following 8×6 integer matrix A (its columns are linearly independent) and vector b.

A =
[ -1   0  -1  -3   2   1 ]
[ -1  -1   0  -2   2  -3 ]
[  0  -1   1  -1   1  -1 ]
[  1   0   1   2  -2   1 ]
[  1   0   1   3  -2   0 ]
[  0  -1   0  -1   1  -2 ]
[  1   0   0   1  -1   0 ]
[ -1   0   0  -1   0   1 ]

b (as a column) =
[ -1 ]
[  4 ]
[  4 ]
[  2 ]
[  4 ]
[  3 ]
[ -4 ]
[  1 ]

Find the least-squares solution x, i.e. the vector minimising ‖A x − b‖² (Euclidean norm). Give x_1, …, x_n as one comma-separated list of exact numbers (integers or exact fractions a/b where needed).

Think it through, then finish with a final line of the form `ANSWER: <your answer>`.

context.instruction: Solve your problem. Return one submit action with the answer and a short description of your solution (2-3 sentences).
